header.running_head: Leading the Salaah and Following the Imaam During the Time of Rasulullaah ﷺ

blocks.text: Also quoted in the same chapter[^1] is the statement that Hadhrat Ali (RA) and Hadhrat Zubayr (RA) made when they said, "However, we are also of the opinion that Abu Bakr (RA) is most worthy of the post after Rasulullaah ﷺ. He was the companion of Rasulullaah ﷺ in the cave and the 'second of the two'. We definitely acknowledge his status and his seniority. After all, Rasulullaah ﷺ did instruct him to lead the Muslims in salaah while Rasulullaah ﷺ was alive."
The Statements of Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Ali (RA) Concerning Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Leading the Salaah

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away, the Ansaar said, "There should be an Ameer from us and one from you (Muhaajireen)." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then went to them and said, "Did you not know that Rasulullaah ﷺ had placed Abu Bakr (RA) forward (to lead the salaah)?" The Ansaar then said, "Allaah forbid that we should ever place ourselves ahead of Abu Bakr (RA)!" [^2]

Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "Rasulullaah ﷺ certainly instructed Abu Bakr (RA) to lead the salaah when I was present, neither unavailable nor ill. Therefore, to take charge of our matters of this world (as Khalifah) we are pleased to have the person whom Nabi ﷺ selected to take charge of our matters of Deen (our salaah)." [^3]
The Statement of Hadhrat Salmaan Faarsi (RA) Concerning the Leadership of Arabs

Hadhrat Abu Layla Kindi reports that Hadhrat Salmaan Faarsi (RA) once arrived with a group of twelve or thirteen riders from amongst the companions of Rasulullaah ﷺ. When the time for salaah arrived, the others addressed Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) saying, "Go forward (to lead the salaah), O Abu Abdullaah." Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) declined saying, "We (non-Arabs) cannot lead you (Arabs) in salaah nor marry your women because it is through you that Allaah has guided us." One of the men from the group then went ahead and performed four Rakaahs salaah. After he had completed, Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) said, "Why did we need to perform four Rakaahs salaah when half of it (two Rakaahs) would have sufficed. (Since we are on a journey) We are most in need of concessions." [^4]
